note: Written by scripts/generate-product-pages.js on every --confirm run, from the same figures it substitutes into the page. backend/lib/claimRegistry.js reads it so its build-cost entries need not hardcode a month or a dollar figure. Every sentence here is asserted present exactly once in the rendered text of the page named above; the build fails otherwise. Do not hand-edit.

buildcost-current-level.describes: dollar level of the build_current basket for the latest complete month, and the same basket a year earlier
buildcost-current-level.sentence: Current build (32GB DDR5-6000 + 1TB NVMe + 2TB NVMe): $1,024, up from $348 in August 2025

buildcost-ddr4-level.describes: dollar level of the build_ddr4 basket for the latest complete month, and the same basket a year earlier
buildcost-ddr4-level.sentence: DDR4 build (32GB DDR4-3200 + 1TB NVMe): $388, up from $161 in August 2025

buildcost-citation.describes: the ready-to-quote sentence, stating the current-build level and its year-earlier level as approximations with the source named
buildcost-citation.sentence: The memory and storage in MemRadar's current-build basket cost about $1,024 in August 2026, up from about $348 a year earlier. Source: MemRadar Build-Cost Index, August 2026.

buildcost-yoy-range.describes: the minimum and maximum year-over-year change of the build_current basket across every month of the published series that has a same-month predecessor, each labelled with the month it measures
buildcost-yoy-range.sentence: For the current build it has run from -20.1% in January 2024 to +210.7% in May 2026, measured across the published monthly series
